sources.note: Main TronsHealth website. Single-page marketing site describing EHR, Practice Management, Patient Engagement, and Credentialing modules. No deep feature pages (subpages return 404). No pricing, customer counts, or case studies.
Mandatory disclosures page links to a PDF download (Mandatory-Disclosures.pdf) but the PDF URL returned 404. Page itself has no inline content.
Parent company Tronsit Solutions — managed IT services provider. Lists Healthcare Solutions as a service category alongside Managed IT, Cybersecurity, Cloud, etc.
Tronsit Solutions about page. Founded July 2017 in Pakistan, expanded to Australia 2019, registered US LLC 2021-2022. Three managing directors: Tahir Sabir, Khaleeq Alvi, Adeel Alvi.
Healthcare solutions page for Tronsit Solutions. Page content was JavaScript-rendered and not fully accessible, but confirms healthcare is a service area.
BBB profile for Tronsit Solutions LLC. Founded Sept 2022 (US), accredited Feb 2025, A+ rating, no complaints. Same Balcones Dr address as TronsHealth. Lists Khaleeq Alvi as Managing Member.
RocketReach profile for Khaleeq Alvi. Lists him as Managing Director at Tronsit Solutions with prior experience at CureMD, Brain Telecommunication Ltd, and NETS-International Communication.
The Org profile for Khaleeq Alvi at Tronsit Solutions. Confirms Managing Director role.
DesignRush profile for Tronsit Solutions. Could not access (403 forbidden).
ZoomInfo overview of Tronsit Solutions. Search result confirmed company offers EHR/EMR, CRM, HRMS, and production processing solutions.
